# Cncf Micrometer Reviewer

Review Micrometer using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Observability category. As an instrumentation facade, Micrometer allows you to instrument your code with dimensional metrics with a vendor-neutral interface and decide on the observability system as a last step. Instrumenting your core library code with Micrometer allows the libraries to be included in applications that ship data to different backends.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
